landing.heroSubtitle: Automate third-party ICT risk assessments, identify compliance gaps against DORA requirements, and get instant answers from an AI copilot trained on your documentation.
landing.featuresHeading: Everything you need to meet DORA obligations

gapAnalysis.title: Automated Gap Analysis
gapAnalysis.desc: Upload vendor ICT documentation and get a structured DORA compliance gap report in minutes.

questionnaires.title: Vendor Questionnaires
questionnaires.desc: Auto-generate security questionnaires, invite vendors to respond, and get LLM-scored compliance results instantly.

copilot.title: DORA Copilot
copilot.desc: Ask compliance questions in natural language. The agentic copilot searches your docs and DORA articles.

monitoring.title: Monitoring Alerts
monitoring.desc: Automated 24-hour alerts for certification expiry (90/30/7 days), contract renewal, and overdue assessments.

roi.title: Register of Information
roi.desc: One-click EBA-compliant DORA Article 28(3) XLSX export — RT.01.01 to RT.04.01 sheets generated automatically.

score.title: Live Compliance Score
score.desc: A real-time DORA compliance score per workspace, with a 30-day trend and Red/Amber/Green status — board-ready at a glance.

riskRegister.title: Risk Register
riskRegister.desc: Track vendor risk decisions, criticality tiers, and gap remediation across your whole third-party estate in one register.

reports.title: Regulator-Ready Reports
reports.desc: Generate a downloadable Word (.docx) DORA gap-analysis report per vendor — formatted for review and submission.

security.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
security.desc: Workspace isolation, MFA, PII detection, audit logging, and encrypted secrets — built for regulated industries.

landing.ingestionSubtitle: Upload vendor contracts, ICT policies, and audit reports — parsed, chunked, and embedded into a high-quality RAG pipeline automatically.

ingestionItems.selfHosted: Self-hosted embeddings — your content stays private

landing.ingestionFootnote: Fill in a form — Retrieva handles the rest.

index.title: Index Documentation
index.desc: Upload vendor contracts, ICT policies, and audit reports. Retrieva parses, chunks, and embeds them automatically.

assess.title: Run DORA Assessment
assess.desc: AI analyses documents against each DORA article and classifies coverage as covered, partial, or missing.

invite.title: Invite Vendors
invite.desc: Send tokenised due diligence questionnaires and get scored responses back without vendor logins.

ask.title: Ask the Copilot
ask.desc: Query your knowledge base in natural language and get cited answers grounded in your own documentation.

export.title: Export Evidence
export.desc: Generate regulator-ready outputs including the Register of Information and gap remediation artefacts.
